senses.gloss:
m. (-क्षः)
A young Brahman in his noviciate, one who has begun to read the Vedas.
E.
शिक्षा the pronunciation of the language of the Vedas, अण् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ती-तं)
Sandy in general.
n. (-तं)
A sand-bank or an island with sandy shores.
E.
सिकता sandy soil, and अण् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Living in doubt and error.
m. (-कः)
1 A religious mendicant.
2 An ascetic.
n. (-कं)
A thread worn round the wrist or neck, &c. to secure good fortune.
E.
सिकता sand, &c., ठक् aff.
